cues.text: Look at the next isolated Huawei router lab.
The static route directs one ninety-two dot one sixty-eight dot thirty dot zero slash twenty-four through ten dot zero dot zero dot two.
OSPF process one uses backbone area zero dot zero dot zero dot zero.

The network statements cover ten dot zero dot zero dot zero with wildcard zero dot zero dot zero dot three, and one ninety-two dot one sixty-eight dot ten dot zero with wildcard zero dot zero dot zero dot two fifty-five.
A wildcard mask is not the same as an ordinary subnet mask.
Inspect OSPF peers and the routing table.
Adjust statements for your actual topology.
The RIP alternative uses RIP process one, version two, and appropriate network statements.
Route selection uses longest matching prefix first, then preference and metric when comparing equivalent prefixes.
Test with ping, traceroute and routing tables.
For the capstone, headquarters and two branch routers establish backbone adjacencies and advertise their local VLAN subnets.
In an isolated simulator, disable a redundant link and observe convergence rather than merely assuming failover works.
